Decipher.com Premiere card image for [[Gold 5]] (Wayback, 29 June 2001). It has the black border of Premiere Limited but prints the game text of [[Gold 5 (Unlimited)|Premiere Unlimited]] (April 1996), which added “Must have pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.”; the printed Limited face is [[:File:Premiere-L-gold5-hires.webp]].

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010629133754/http://www.decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/images/gold5.gif Decipher.com card image] (Wayback copy of decipher.com/starwars/cardlists).

Do not replace the Holotable D-E1 face [[File:Premiere-L-gold5.gif]].
